items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Well, Lester Lanin is crazy about him.

ctx.x: Oh, sure. I saw him at some point when they had a Lester Lanin band, and there he was.
Well, Lester Lanin is crazy about him.
Speaking about Chief reminds a little of Jack Teagarden, maybe because people used to say that Teagarden was part-Indian. But you mentioned once that you ran into him in Kansas City.
